title: Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit Terms: Application Fee Discount on a Mortgage Loan File
content:
A Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit — one of Larkspur's Closing Cost Credit programs — reserved against a Mortgage Loan File earns a dollar discount on that file's application fee, according to the credit's status and the occupation verified on it.

**Terms.** Where the Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit reserved against the file is verified and its verified occupation is firefighter, law enforcement or emergency medical, 100.00 USD is taken off the application fee; where that credit is verified and its verified occupation is active military or veteran, k12 educator or nurse, 50.00 USD is taken off; where the file carries no verified Hometown Heroes Credit nothing is taken off.

| Hometown Heroes Credit against the file | Verified occupation | Taken off the application fee |
|---|---|---|
| verified | firefighter | 100.00 USD |
| verified | law enforcement | 100.00 USD |
| verified | emergency medical | 100.00 USD |
| verified | active military or veteran | 50.00 USD |
| verified | k12 educator | 50.00 USD |
| verified | nurse | 50.00 USD |
| none verified against the file | — | nothing |

**Points of judgement.**

- The credit that counts is the Hometown Heroes Credit in verified status against this loan file in the Closing Cost Credit records; a credit still reserved and awaiting verification, or one that has expired or been forfeited, takes nothing off.
- The occupation is the occupation verified on that credit, not one the customer states on the call.
